underdog.heading: Why Colorado can keep it close
bullets: Playing at Colorado is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
The outcome range is 14.8 points wide at one sigma — p10 -37.6 to p90 +4.4 for Colorado, so a projection of -15.6 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 1%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
